summary: Enforce M36 Root schema version in M666 and require M1296 envelopes to pin schema and content versions.
rationale: M666 derives its 0-based gene address space from M36. It must reject unsupported M36 schemas and ensure M1296 references the exact schema and content identity used for the index.
verification: Reject missing or unsupported M36 standard_version.
Reject missing or mismatched M1296 root_schema_version and root_genome_version.
Run M666 tests and package build.
notes: Pins core interoperability contract 1.1.0. No Root Genome mutation or graph runtime change.
